objects.yaml:
type: "weather-forecast"
entity: "ada_studio.weather_1"
forecast_type: "daily"
show_current: true
show_forecast: true

type: "gauge"
entity: "ada_studio.sensor_home_consumption_1"
name: "Home power"
min: 0
max: 6

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.scene_day_1"
name: "Day"
icon: "mdi:white-balance-sunny"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.scene_evening_1"
name: "Evening"
icon: "mdi:sofa"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.scene_cinema_1"
name: "Movie"
icon: "mdi:television"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.scene_night_1"
name: "Night"
icon: "mdi:weather-night"
show_state: false

type: "tile"
entity: "ada_studio.light_floor_lamp_1"
name: "Floor lamp"
features:
  - type: "light-brightness"

type: "tile"
entity: "ada_studio.light_bedside_lamp_1"
name: "Bedside lamp"
features:
  - type: "light-brightness"

type: "tile"
entity: "ada_studio.cover_living_room_window_1"
name: "Roller shutter"
features:
  - type: "cover-open-close"

type: "gauge"
entity: "ada_studio.sensor_gas_today_1"
name: "Gas today"
min: 0
max: 5

type: custom:mini-graph-card
name: Indoor temperature
icon: mdi:home-thermometer
hours_to_show: 24
points_per_hour: 2
line_width: 3
smoothing: true
show:
  labels: true
  legend: false
  fill: fade
entities:
- entity: ada_studio.sensor_living_room_temperature_1
  name: Living room
  color: '#ff9800'
- entity: ada_studio.sensor_bedroom_temperature_1
  name: Bedroom
  color: '#4dd0e1'
  show_state: true

type: custom:mini-graph-card
name: Outdoor temperature
icon: mdi:sun-thermometer
hours_to_show: 24
points_per_hour: 2
line_width: 3
smoothing: true
show:
  labels: true
  legend: true
  fill: fade
color_thresholds:
  - value: 6
    color: '#4dd0e1'
  - value: 12
    color: '#ffca28'
  - value: 15
    color: '#ff7043'
entities:
  - entity: ada_studio.sensor_outside_temperature_1
    name: Outdoor

type: "entities"
title: "Doors & windows"
state_color: true
entities:
  - entity: "ada_studio.binary_sensor_front_door_1"
    name: "Front door"
  - entity: "ada_studio.binary_sensor_garage_door_1"
    name: "Garage door"
  - entity: "ada_studio.binary_sensor_bathroom_window_1"
    name: "Bathroom window"
  - entity: "ada_studio.binary_sensor_living_room_french_window_1"
    name: "Living room French door"
  - entity: "ada_studio.binary_sensor_bedroom_windows_1"
    name: "Bedroom windows"

type: "custom:power-flow-card-plus"
kw_decimals: 2
watt_threshold: 1000
clickable_entities: true
use_new_flow_rate_model: true
entities:
  grid:
    entity: "ada_studio.sensor_grid_power_1"
    name: "Grid"
  solar:
    entity: "ada_studio.sensor_solar_power_1"
    name: "Solar"
  battery:
    entity: "ada_studio.sensor_battery_power_1"
    state_of_charge: "ada_studio.sensor_battery_level_1"
    name: "Battery"
  home:
    entity: "ada_studio.sensor_home_consumption_1"
    name: "Home"

type: "statistics-graph"
title: "Energy this week"
chart_type: "bar"
period: "day"
days_to_show: 7
stat_types:
  - "change"
entities:
  - entity: "ada_studio.sensor_solar_energy_1"
    name: "Solar"
  - entity: "ada_studio.sensor_grid_energy_1"
    name: "Grid"

type: "gauge"
entity: "ada_studio.sensor_cost_today_1"
name: "Cost today"
min: 0
max: 5

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.script_evening_jazz_1"
name: "Evening jazz"
icon: "mdi:saxophone"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.script_radio_1"
name: "Radio"
icon: "mdi:radio"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.script_podcast_1"
name: "Podcast"
icon: "mdi:podcast"
show_state: false

type: "button"
entity: "ada_studio.scene_relax_1"
name: "Relax"
icon: "mdi:sofa"
show_state: false

type: "tile"
entity: "ada_studio.media_player_living_room_1"
name: "Living room"
features:
  - type: "media-player-volume-slider"

ph.n: Binary sensor living room french window 1
